items.name: Aura X9 Pro 5G
items.shortDescription: 6.8" LTPO AMOLED, 200MP camera, 5,100mAh battery with 120W wired charging. The flagship we recommend most often.
items.description: The Aura X9 Pro is built for people who use their phone as their main camera, their office and their cinema. A 6.8-inch LTPO AMOLED panel ramps between 1Hz and 120Hz so scrolling feels instant while the battery lasts all day. The 200MP main sensor uses pixel binning to produce bright 12.5MP shots in low light, and the periscope telephoto reaches 5x optical zoom without softening.

items.name: Nova Edge 5G
items.shortDescription: Curved 6.5" AMOLED, 108MP camera and 67W fast charging in a 178g aluminium frame.
items.description: The Nova Edge 5G is the sweet spot of our range: flagship-grade materials, a curved 6.5-inch 120Hz AMOLED display and a 108MP camera that holds detail in daylight. At 178 grams it disappears in a pocket, and 67W charging refills the 4,800mAh cell in about 34 minutes.

items.name: Pulse Mini 4G
items.shortDescription: Compact 5.9" phone with a 50MP camera, clean software and two-day battery life.
items.description: Not everyone wants a tablet in their pocket. The Pulse Mini keeps a 5.9-inch screen, a 50MP main camera and a 4,500mAh battery that comfortably reaches two days of light use. It ships with a clean, bloat-free build and receives quarterly security patches.

items.name: Vertex Book 14 Pro
items.shortDescription: 14" 2.8K 120Hz display, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD and an all-metal chassis at 1.29kg.
items.description: The Vertex Book 14 Pro is the laptop we hand to designers and developers. The 2.8K 120Hz panel covers 100% of the sRGB gamut, the 1TB NVMe drive keeps large projects responsive, and the backlit keyboard has 1.5mm of travel. A 75Wh battery gives around 12 hours of mixed office work.

items.name: Vertex Studio 16
items.shortDescription: 16" colour-accurate workstation with discrete graphics for editing, CAD and 3D work.
items.description: A desktop replacement for heavy creative work. The Studio 16 pairs a 16-inch 3.2K mini-LED display with discrete graphics and a vapour-chamber cooler that holds sustained clocks during long renders. It ships with a 99Wh battery, a full-size SD reader and Thunderbolt 4.

items.name: Slate Air 13
items.shortDescription: Fanless 13" ultraportable, 1.08kg, 16 hours of battery and a magnesium body.
items.description: The Slate Air 13 is silent because it has no fan. A magnesium-alloy body keeps it at 1.08kg, the 13.3-inch display is bright enough for outdoor work, and 16 hours of rated battery life means the charger can stay at home. The ideal second computer for travel and study.

items.name: Lumina 55" QLED
items.shortDescription: 55" 4K QLED with Dolby Vision IQ, 120Hz gaming mode and a slim 6.9mm bezel.
items.description: A 55-inch QLED panel with full-array local dimming across 48 zones, Dolby Vision IQ and Dolby Atmos passthrough. Two HDMI 2.1 ports run 4K at 120Hz with ALLM and VRR, so consoles and PC cards both behave. The 6.9mm profile mounts almost flush to the wall.

items.name: Lumina 65" OLED
items.shortDescription: 65" OLED with perfect blacks, 0.1ms response and a 144Hz gaming mode for current consoles.
items.description: OLED changes what you notice in a dark scene: per-pixel lighting means no halo around subtitles and no grey wash over space documentaries. The 65-inch panel runs up to 144Hz with HDR10 and Dolby Vision, and the anti-reflection coating keeps a bright room usable.

items.name: Nova 43" Smart TV
items.shortDescription: 43" 4K smart television with HDR10 and a built-in streaming hub for bedrooms and rentals.
items.description: A practical 43-inch 4K set for a bedroom, kitchen or rental unit. HDR10 support, three HDMI inputs and a streaming hub with the major apps already installed. The stand is narrow enough for a small console table and VESA 200x200 mounts are supported.

items.name: PulseBuds Pro ANC
items.shortDescription: Hybrid active noise cancellation, 42-hour case battery and multipoint Bluetooth 5.3.
items.description: Four microphones per earbud cancel up to 42dB of low-frequency noise, which is enough to erase engine drone on a flight. Multipoint Bluetooth 5.3 keeps a laptop and phone connected at once, and the case adds 30 hours on top of the 12 in the buds.

items.name: Sonora 700 Over-Ear
items.shortDescription: Studio-tuned over-ear headphones with 60-hour battery, ANC and a fold-flat travel case.
items.description: Memory-foam earcups and a 40mm bio-cellulose driver give the Sonora 700 a warm, controlled low end without hiding vocals. Sixty hours of playback with ANC off, 38 with it on, and USB-C audio passthrough for wired monitoring.

items.name: Bassline Go Speaker
items.shortDescription: IP67 portable speaker, 24-hour battery, stereo pairing and a rugged carry loop.
items.description: A 30W portable speaker that survives a poolside afternoon. IP67 sealing covers dust and a 30-minute dunk, the passive radiator adds real low end for its size, and two units pair into a stereo set. Twenty-four hours at half volume.

items.name: VoltCharge 65W GaN
items.shortDescription: Three-port GaN charger: 2x USB-C plus USB-A, folding pins and 65W total output.
items.description: GaN internals make a 65W three-port charger small enough to leave in a bag. It splits power intelligently across two USB-C ports and one USB-A, supports PD 3.1 and PPS, and the pins fold flat for travel. Charges a 14-inch laptop at full speed from a single port.

items.name: PowerCore 20K
items.shortDescription: 20,000mAh power bank with 65W USB-C output, a digital display and airline-safe capacity.
items.description: Enough capacity for three phone charges or one laptop top-up. The USB-C port delivers 65W out and takes 65W in, so the pack refills in about 90 minutes, and the display shows the exact percentage instead of four vague dots.

items.name: CableFlex USB-C 100W
items.shortDescription: Braided 2m USB-C cable rated for 100W charging, 480Mbps data and 10,000 bends.
items.description: A cable that stops being the weak link. 100W / 5A rated for laptop charging, 480Mbps data, aluminium housings and a braided jacket tested to 10,000 bends. Available in 1m and 2m, and the 2m version reaches a sofa without pulling the plug out.

items.name: HomeHub AX6 Router
items.shortDescription: Wi-Fi 6 dual-band router, 3,000Mbps aggregate, 4 antennas and mesh-ready firmware.
items.description: A Wi-Fi 6 router that covers a typical apartment without drama. OFDMA and 160MHz channels push 3,000Mbps aggregate across 2.4 and 5GHz, four external antennas hold signal through two walls, and the firmware supports adding a second unit as a mesh node.

items.name: SecureCam 2K
items.shortDescription: 2K indoor security camera with colour night vision, two-way audio and local SD recording.
items.description: A 2K camera with a 360-degree pan range, colour night vision down to 0.1 lux, motion zones and two-way audio through the app. Recording stays on a local microSD card by default, so there is no mandatory subscription.

items.name: VoltMeter Pro DM-80
items.shortDescription: True-RMS digital multimeter with auto-ranging, 10A DC current and a CAT III 600V rating.
items.description: A workshop meter that does not lie about AC readings. True-RMS measurement, auto-ranging to 600V, 10A DC current, continuity beep, diode and capacitance tests, and a CAT III 600V safety rating with fused inputs. Backlit display for dim cabinets.
